Task: Federated Login Flow

Write Python code that fetches and normalizes federated user profile claims using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
import os
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional

import requests


class Auth0FederatedProfileClient:
    def __init__(self, issuer_base_url: Optional[str] = None, api_token: Optional[str] = None, timeout: int = 20):
        self.issuer_base_url = (issuer_base_url or os.getenv("AUTH0_DOMAIN", "")).rstrip("/")
        self.api_token = api_token or os.getenv("AUTH0_MGMT_API_TOKEN")
        self.timeout = timeout

        if not self.issuer_base_url:
            raise ValueError("Auth0 domain is required via issuer_base_url or AUTH0_DOMAIN.")
        if not self.api_token:
            raise ValueError("Auth0 management API token is required via api_token or AUTH0_MGMT_API_TOKEN.")

    def fetch_user_profile(self, user_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        url = f"https://{self.issuer_base_url}/api/v2/users/{user_id}"
        headers = {
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {self.api_token}",
            "Accept": "application/json",
        }
        resp = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=self.timeout)
        resp.raise_for_status()
        return resp.json()

    @staticmethod
    def normalize_claims(profile: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        identities = profile.get("identities") or []
        primary_identity = identities[0] if identities else {}

        email = profile.get("email")
        email_verified = profile.get("email_verified")
        name = profile.get("name") or profile.get("nickname") or profile.get("given_name") or ""
        given_name = profile.get("given_name") or ""
        family_name = profile.get("family_name") or ""
        picture = profile.get("picture") or profile.get("avatar") or ""
        locale = profile.get("locale") or ""

        normalized = {
            "subject": profile.get("user_id") or profile.get("sub") or "",
            "issuer": primary_identity.get("issuer") or profile.get("iss") or "",
            "provider": primary_identity.get("provider") or "",
            "connection": primary_identity.get("connection") or "",
            "email": email or "",
            "email_verified": bool(email_verified) if email_verified is not None else False,
            "name": name,
            "given_name": given_name,
            "family_name": family_name,
            "picture": picture,
            "locale": locale,
            "profile_url": profile.get("profile") or profile.get("url") or "",
            "raw_claims": {
                "sub": profile.get("sub"),
                "iss": profile.get("iss"),
                "aud": profile.get("aud"),
                "exp": profile.get("exp"),
                "iat": profile.get("iat"),
                "auth_time": profile.get("auth_time"),
                "nonce": profile.get("nonce"),
                "email": email,
                "email_verified": email_verified,
                "name": profile.get("name"),
                "given_name": profile.get("given_name"),
                "family_name": profile.get("family_name"),
                "nickname": profile.get("nickname"),
                "picture": picture,
                "locale": locale,
                "updated_at": profile.get("updated_at"),
            },
        }

        user_metadata = profile.get("user_metadata") or {}
        app_metadata = profile.get("app_metadata") or {}

        normalized["metadata"] = {
            "user": user_metadata,
            "app": app_metadata,
        }

        return normalized

    def fetch_and_normalize(self, user_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        profile = self.fetch_user_profile(user_id)
        return self.normalize_claims(profile)
